"""Closed, pre-adoption Projects corrections; no module code is executed.

The committed manifest binds the complete input/output trees and proposal bytes.
Only the network transport is replaceable by real-Git qualification fixtures.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import base64
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

_SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("_g6_delivery_runtime", Path(__file__).with_name("delivery_runtime.py"))
rt = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_SPEC)
sys.modules[_SPEC.name] = rt
_SPEC.loader.exec_module(rt)

PROJECTS = "Hexalith.Projects"
MANIFEST = "docs/proposals/projects-g6-catalog.json"
PATCH = "docs/proposals/projects-g6-catalog.patch"
WORKFLOW = ".github/workflows/ci.yml"
ACTION = ".github/actions/prepare-g6-catalog/"
PATHS = (WORKFLOW, ACTION + "action.yml", ACTION + "prepare.py")
SOURCES = ("tools/deliver_g6_catalog.py", "tools/delivery_runtime.py", MANIFEST, PATCH,
           ACTION + "action.yml", ACTION + "prepare.py")

GATES_MANIFEST = "docs/proposals/projects-ci-gates.json"
GATES_PATCH = "docs/proposals/projects-ci-gates.patch"
GATES_VALIDATION = "docs/proposals/projects-ci-gates-validation.json"
GATES_CHECKS = frozenset({"focused_suites", "workflow_gates", "npm_install", "npm_signatures",
                          "commit_policy", "npm_vulnerabilities"})
GATES_WORKFLOW = ".github/workflows/deliver-projects-ci-gates.yml"
GATES_PATHS = ("tests/tools/test_render_skill.py", "tests/tools/test_release_workflow.py",
               "tests/tools/test_run_g6_candidate_gate.py", "tests/tools/test_g6_mapper_build.py",
               "package.json", "package-lock.json", "tests/tools/run-frontcomposer-inspect-gate.ps1",
               "tests/tools/run-ci-workflow-gates.ps1", "tests/tools/test_run_ci_workflow_gates.py")
GATES_SOURCES = ("tools/deliver_g6_catalog.py", "tools/delivery_runtime.py", GATES_MANIFEST,
                 GATES_PATCH, GATES_WORKFLOW, GATES_VALIDATION)


def configuration(name):
    """Select one reviewed, fixed perimeter; never accept caller-supplied paths."""
    require(name in {"catalog", "ci-gates"}, "unknown closed Projects delivery profile")
    if name == "catalog":
        return {"manifest": MANIFEST, "patch": PATCH, "paths": PATHS, "sources": SOURCES,
                "existing": {WORKFLOW}, "schema": "hexalith.projects-g6-catalog.v1",
                "plan_schema": "hexalith.projects-g6-catalog-plan.v1",
                "receipt_schema": "hexalith.projects-g6-catalog-delivery.v1",
                "message": b"build(cicd): acquire reviewed Projects G-6 catalog\n"}
    return {"manifest": GATES_MANIFEST, "patch": GATES_PATCH, "paths": GATES_PATHS,
            "sources": GATES_SOURCES, "existing": {GATES_PATHS[0], *GATES_PATHS[6:]},
            "schema": "hexalith.projects-ci-gates.v1", "plan_schema": "hexalith.projects-ci-gates-plan.v1",
            "receipt_schema": "hexalith.projects-ci-gates-delivery.v1",
            "message": b"build(cicd): restore reviewed Projects gate prerequisites\n"}


class Git(rt.Git):
    """Keep bounded combined push diagnostics without changing the shared runtime."""
    def run(self, *args, **options):
        if not args or args[0] != "push":
            return super().run(*args, **options)
        token = options.get("token")
        require(token, "scoped Projects App token unavailable")
        self.budget.check(token=True)
        env = self.env.copy()
        header = base64.b64encode(("x-access-token:" + token).encode()).decode()
        rt._SECRETS.extend((token, header))
        index = int(env["GIT_CONFIG_COUNT"])
        env.update({"GIT_CONFIG_COUNT": str(index + 1), f"GIT_CONFIG_KEY_{index}": "http.https://github.com/.extraheader",
                    f"GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_{index}": "AUTHORIZATION: basic " + header})
        self.push_diagnostics = {"exit_code": None, "output": "", "timed_out": False}
        timeout = self.budget.timeout()
        with tempfile.TemporaryFile() as output:
            process = subprocess.Popen(["git", "-C", str(self.root), *map(str, args)],
                                       stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, env=env, start_new_session=True)
            try:
                process.wait(timeout=timeout)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                self.push_diagnostics["timed_out"] = True
                try:
                    os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                except ProcessLookupError:
                    pass
                process.wait()
            output.seek(0)
            data = output.read(rt.MAX_GIT + 1)
        self.push_diagnostics.update(exit_code=process.returncode,
                                     output=rt.clean(data[:rt.MAX_GIT].decode("utf-8", "replace")))
        require(not self.push_diagnostics["timed_out"], "Git push timed out; remote outcome is ambiguous")
        require(len(data) <= rt.MAX_GIT, "Git push diagnostics exceed 16 MiB limit; remote outcome is ambiguous")
        return process.returncode, data


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise rt.DeliveryError(message)


def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def manifest(data, profile="catalog"):
    config = configuration(profile)
    value = rt.json_read(data)
    keys = {"schema", "repository", "base_commit", "base_tree", "patch_sha256", "result_tree", "before", "after", "pre_push_gate"}
    if profile == "ci-gates":
        keys.add("validation_sha256")
    require(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == keys, "invalid closed catalog delivery manifest")
    require(value["schema"] == config["schema"] and value["repository"] == PROJECTS,
            "catalog delivery repository/schema mismatch")
    require(value["pre_push_gate"] in {"pending-owner-decision", "reviewed-tree-owner-authorized"},
            "invalid closed pre-push owner gate")
    for key in ("base_commit", "base_tree", "result_tree"):
        rt.sha(value[key])
    require(isinstance(value["patch_sha256"], str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", value["patch_sha256"]),
            "invalid proposal SHA256")
    if profile == "ci-gates":
        require(isinstance(value["validation_sha256"], str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", value["validation_sha256"]),
                "invalid reviewed module validation SHA256")
    for key in ("before", "after"):
        require(isinstance(value[key], dict) and set(value[key]) == set(config["paths"]), "unexpected manifest path")
        for path, item in value[key].items():
            if key == "before" and path not in config["existing"]:
                require(item is None, "catalog action must be absent at reviewed base" if profile == "catalog"
                        else "new gate-repair paths must be absent at reviewed base")
            else:
                require(isinstance(item, list) and len(item) == 3 and item[:2] == ["100644", "blob"],
                        "catalog delivery requires regular nonexecutable blobs")
                rt.sha(item[2])
    return value


def module_validation(data, value):
    """Bind independently reviewed secret-free checks to this exact module result."""
    require(digest(data) == value["validation_sha256"], "reviewed module validation SHA256 mismatch")
    proof = rt.json_read(data)
    require(isinstance(proof, dict) and set(proof) == {
        "schema", "status", "base_commit", "base_tree", "result_tree", "patch_sha256", "checks"},
        "invalid closed reviewed module validation proof")
    require(proof["schema"] == "hexalith.projects-ci-gates-validation.v1" and proof["status"] == "passed",
            "reviewed module validation did not pass")
    for field in ("base_commit", "base_tree", "result_tree", "patch_sha256"):
        require(proof[field] == value[field], "reviewed module validation source/proposal mismatch: " + field)
    checks = proof["checks"]
    require(isinstance(checks, dict) and set(checks) == GATES_CHECKS,
            "reviewed module validation required checks differ")
    for name in GATES_CHECKS:
        check = checks[name]
        require(isinstance(check, dict) and set(check) == {"status", "log_sha256"} and check["status"] == "passed" and
                isinstance(check["log_sha256"], str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", check["log_sha256"]),
                "reviewed module validation check did not pass: " + name)
    return proof


def entries(git, revision, expected):
    actual = git.items(revision)
    for path, item in expected.items():
        require(actual.get(path) == (tuple(item) if item else None), "unexpected catalog source blob/mode: " + path)
    return actual


def proposal(owner, source, target, value, profile="catalog"):
    config = configuration(profile)
    patch = owner.blob(source, config["patch"])
    require(digest(patch) == value["patch_sha256"], "reviewed proposal SHA256 mismatch")
    base = value["base_commit"]
    require(target.resolve(base + "^{tree}") == value["base_tree"], "reviewed base tree mismatch")
    before = entries(target, base, value["before"])
    target.run("read-tree", value["base_tree"])
    target.run("apply", "--cached", "--whitespace=nowarn", data=patch)
    tree = target.resolve(target.run("write-tree", "--missing-ok").decode().strip())
    require(tree == value["result_tree"], "complete proposal output tree mismatch")
    after = entries(target, tree, value["after"])
    changed = {path for path in set(before) | set(after) if before.get(path) != after.get(path)}
    require(changed == set(config["paths"]), "proposal changed paths outside the three-path correction"
            if profile == "catalog" else "proposal changed paths outside the closed nine-path gate repair")
    if profile == "catalog":
        for path in PATHS[1:]:
            require(target.blob(tree, path) == owner.blob(source, path), "catalog action differs from owner payload")
    else:
        for path in GATES_PATHS:
            require(target.blob(tree, path), "repaired gate payload is missing or empty")
    return tree


def plan(source, value, manifest_bytes, live, profile="catalog"):
    binding = {"schema": configuration(profile)["plan_schema"], "owner_source": source,
            "manifest_sha256": digest(manifest_bytes), "patch_sha256": value["patch_sha256"],
            "pre_push_gate": value["pre_push_gate"],
            "base_commit": value["base_commit"], "base_tree": value["base_tree"],
            "result_tree": value["result_tree"], "observed_main": live}
    if profile == "ci-gates":
        binding["profile"] = profile
        binding["module_validation_sha256"] = value["validation_sha256"]
    return binding


def parents(git, revision):
    header = git.run("cat-file", "commit", revision).split(b"\n\n", 1)[0]
    return [line[7:].decode("ascii") for line in header.splitlines() if line.startswith(b"parent ")]


def exclude_full_writer(owner, source, transport, receipt, phase):
    """Prove this unregistered target is absent from both full-writer selectors."""
    proof = {"phase": phase, "owner_source": source, "registry_absent": None, "accepted_ref_absent": None,
             "advertised_main": None, "owner_main_matches_source": None}
    receipt["full_writer_exclusion"].append(proof)
    receipt["failed_operation"] = "verify Projects registry absence during " + phase
    registry = rt.registry(owner, source)
    registered = [name for name in registry if name.casefold() == PROJECTS.casefold()]
    proof.update(registry_count=len(registry), registry_sha256=digest(json.dumps(registry, separators=(",", ":")).encode()),
                 registry_absent=not registered, matching_registry_entries=registered[:32])
    require(proof["registry_absent"], "Projects is present in the exact committed full-delivery registry")
    receipt["failed_operation"] = "verify atomic owner-main/accepted-ref advertisement during " + phase
    output = owner.run("ls-remote", "--heads", transport.remote(rt.CICD), "refs/heads/main", "refs/heads/delivered/*")
    proof.update(advertisement_sha256=digest(output), advertisement_bytes=len(output))
    refs = {}
    for row in output.decode("utf-8").splitlines():
        parts = row.split("\t")
        require(len(parts) == 2, "invalid live owner/ref advertisement row")
        revision, reference = parts
        revision = rt.sha(revision)
        if reference == "refs/heads/main":
            require(proof["advertised_main"] is None, "duplicate live owner main advertisement")
            proof["advertised_main"] = revision
            continue
        require(reference.startswith("refs/heads/delivered/"), "unexpected live owner/ref advertisement")
        name = rt.name(reference.removeprefix("refs/heads/delivered/"))
        require(reference not in refs, "duplicate live accepted ref")
        refs[reference] = (name, revision)
    require(proof["advertised_main"] is not None, "missing live owner main advertisement")
    proof["owner_main_matches_source"] = proof["advertised_main"] == source
    require(proof["owner_main_matches_source"], "advertised owner main differs from reviewed source")
    matches = [reference for reference, (name, _) in refs.items() if name.casefold() == PROJECTS.casefold()]
    proof.update(accepted_ref_count=len(refs), accepted_refs_sha256=digest(json.dumps(refs, sort_keys=True).encode()),
                 accepted_ref_absent=not matches, matching_accepted_refs=matches[:32])
    require(proof["accepted_ref_absent"], "Projects has a live full-delivery accepted ref")


def execute(operation, context, report_path, *, transport=None, token="", scratch=None, local_root=None, profile="catalog"):
    """Qualify or deliver using private objects/index, retaining bounded failure receipts."""
    rt._SECRETS.extend([token] if token else [])
    receipt = {"schema": "hexalith.projects-g6-catalog-delivery.v1", "operation": operation,
               "repository": PROJECTS, "owner_source": None,
               "status": "failed", "failed_operation": "authorize owner invocation", "reason": None,
               "observed_main": None, "delivered_sha": None, "delivered_tree": None,
               "candidate_sha": None, "candidate_tree": None, "push_attempted": False, "plan": None,
               "full_writer_exclusion": []}
    try:
        config = configuration(profile)
        receipt["schema"] = config["receipt_schema"]
        require(operation in {"qualify", "deliver"}, "unsupported closed delivery operation")
        require(context.get("G6_PROFILE", profile) == profile, "delivery profile differs from invocation")
        if profile == "ci-gates":
            require(context.get("G6_PROFILE") == profile, "gate-repair profile is required")
            require(context.get("GITHUB_WORKFLOW_REF") ==
                    "Hexalith/Hexalith.CiCd/" + GATES_WORKFLOW + "@refs/heads/main",
                    "ineligible gate-repair owner workflow")
        receipt["failed_operation"] = "verify secret-free behavioral suites"
        behavioral_default = None if profile == "ci-gates" and operation == "qualify" else "success"
        require(context.get("G6_BEHAVIORAL_RESULT", behavioral_default) == "success",
                "secret-free behavioral qualification failed or was skipped")
        receipt["failed_operation"] = "authorize owner invocation"
        require(context.get("GITHUB_REPOSITORY") == "Hexalith/Hexalith.CiCd" and
                context.get("GITHUB_REF") == "refs/heads/main" and
                context.get("GITHUB_EVENT_NAME") == "workflow_dispatch", "ineligible narrow owner invocation")
        source = rt.sha(context.get("G6_OWNER_SOURCE"))
        receipt["owner_source"] = source
        require(source == context.get("GITHUB_SHA"), "owner source differs from dispatch source")
        if operation == "deliver":
            receipt["failed_operation"] = "verify successful secret-free qualification"
            require(context.get("G6_QUALIFICATION") == "success", "secret-free qualification did not succeed")
            receipt["failed_operation"] = "read qualified plan"
            qualified = rt.json_read(context.get("G6_PLAN", ""))
            receipt["failed_operation"] = "require scoped Projects App token"
            require(token, "scoped Projects App token unavailable")
        budget = rt.Budget()
        transport = transport or rt.Transport(budget)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="g6-owner-", dir=scratch) as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            owner = rt.Git(root / "owner.git", budget)
            owner.init()
            receipt["failed_operation"] = "fetch exact CiCd main"
            require(transport.module(owner, rt.CICD) == source, "owner source is not current exact CiCd main")
            receipt["failed_operation"] = "verify committed owner source and manifest"
            source_root = Path(local_root) if local_root else Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
            for path in config["sources"]:
                require((source_root / path).is_file() and not (source_root / path).is_symlink() and
                        (source_root / path).read_bytes() == owner.blob(source, path),
                        "local owner payload differs from exact committed source: " + path)
            raw = owner.blob(source, config["manifest"])
            value = manifest(raw, profile)
            if profile == "ci-gates":
                receipt["failed_operation"] = "verify exact reviewed module validation proof"
                module_validation(owner.blob(source, GATES_VALIDATION), value)
            receipt["failed_operation"] = "verify source-bound pre-push owner gate"
            require(value["pre_push_gate"] == "reviewed-tree-owner-authorized", "pre-push gate is pending owner decision")
            exclude_full_writer(owner, source, transport, receipt, "qualification" if operation == "qualify" else "delivery source verification")
            target = Git(root / "projects.git", budget, index=root / "private-index")
            target.init()
            receipt["failed_operation"] = "fetch exact Projects main"
            live = transport.module(target, PROJECTS)
            receipt["observed_main"] = live
            # The base is fetched by exact object id when main is already the
            # delivered child. No checkout, submodule or module command runs.
            if live != value["base_commit"]:
                receipt["failed_operation"] = "verify already delivered exact tree and direct parent"
                require(target.resolve(live + "^{tree}") == value["result_tree"] and
                        parents(target, live) == [value["base_commit"]], "Projects main differs from reviewed base/result")
                target.run("fetch", "--depth=1", "--no-tags", "--no-recurse-submodules",
                           transport.remote(PROJECTS), value["base_commit"])
            receipt["failed_operation"] = "construct exact reviewed proposal"
            tree = proposal(owner, source, target, value, profile)
            binding = plan(source, value, raw, live, profile)
            receipt["plan"] = binding
            if operation == "deliver":
                receipt["failed_operation"] = "verify qualified source/proposal/main binding"
                require(qualified == binding, "qualified source/proposal/main binding mismatch")
            if operation == "qualify":
                receipt["status"] = "qualified"
            elif live != value["base_commit"]:
                receipt["failed_operation"] = "reread exact CiCd main before unchanged confirmation"
                require(transport.module(owner, rt.CICD) == source, "CiCd main advanced before unchanged confirmation")
                receipt["failed_operation"] = "reread exact Projects main before unchanged confirmation"
                require(transport.module(target, PROJECTS) == live, "Projects main advanced before unchanged confirmation")
                exclude_full_writer(owner, source, transport, receipt, "unchanged confirmation")
                receipt["failed_operation"] = "reread exact Projects main after unchanged exclusion"
                require(transport.module(target, PROJECTS) == live, "Projects main advanced during unchanged exclusion")
                receipt.update(status="unchanged", delivered_sha=live, delivered_tree=tree)
            else:
                receipt["failed_operation"] = "create direct child commit"
                commit = rt.sha(target.run("commit-tree", tree, "-p", live,
                    data=config["message"]).decode().strip())
                require(parents(target, commit) == [live], "delivery commit parent mismatch")
                receipt.update(candidate_sha=commit, candidate_tree=tree)
                receipt["failed_operation"] = "reread exact CiCd main before push"
                require(transport.module(owner, rt.CICD) == source, "CiCd main advanced before push")
                receipt["failed_operation"] = "reread exact Projects main before push"
                require(transport.module(target, PROJECTS) == live, "Projects main advanced before push")
                exclude_full_writer(owner, source, transport, receipt, "push")
                receipt["failed_operation"] = "reread exact Projects main after push exclusion"
                require(transport.module(target, PROJECTS) == live, "Projects main advanced during push exclusion")
                receipt["failed_operation"] = "git push " + commit + ":refs/heads/main"
                receipt["push_attempted"] = True
                try:
                    code, output = transport.push(target, PROJECTS, commit, token)
                    receipt["push_result"] = {"exit_code": code, "output": rt.clean(output.decode("utf-8", "replace"))}
                    require(code == 0, "non-forced Projects push failed; remote outcome may be ambiguous; no retry or reapply")
                except Exception:
                    if "push_result" not in receipt and hasattr(target, "push_diagnostics"):
                        receipt["push_result"] = target.push_diagnostics
                    try:
                        observed = transport.module(target, PROJECTS)
                        observed_tree = target.resolve(observed + "^{tree}")
                        receipt["observed_main"] = observed
                        receipt["reconciliation"] = {"status": "observed", "main": observed, "tree": observed_tree}
                        if observed == commit and observed_tree == tree:
                            receipt.update(delivered_sha=commit, delivered_tree=tree)
                    except Exception as error:
                        receipt["reconciliation"] = {"status": "unavailable", "reason": rt.clean(error)
                            if isinstance(error, rt.DeliveryError) else type(error).__name__}
                    raise
                receipt["failed_operation"] = "reread Projects main after push"
                observed = transport.module(target, PROJECTS)
                receipt["observed_main"] = observed
                require(observed == commit and target.resolve(observed + "^{tree}") == tree,
                        "Projects main changed after push")
                receipt.update(status="delivered", delivered_sha=commit, delivered_tree=tree)
            receipt["failed_operation"] = None
    except Exception as error:
        receipt["reason"] = rt.clean(error) if isinstance(error, rt.DeliveryError) else "catalog owner operation failed: " + type(error).__name__
    rt.atomic(Path(report_path), receipt)
    return receipt


def main(argv=None, *, transport=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("operation", choices=("qualify", "deliver"))
    parser.add_argument("--report", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--profile", choices=("catalog", "ci-gates"), default="catalog")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    context = os.environ.copy()
    tokens = rt.sanitize()
    result = execute(args.operation, context, args.report, transport=transport,
                     token=tokens["MODULE_TOKEN"], scratch=context.get("TMPDIR"), profile=args.profile)
    if args.operation == "qualify" and result["status"] == "qualified" and context.get("GITHUB_OUTPUT"):
        with open(context["GITHUB_OUTPUT"], "a", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            stream.write("plan=" + json.dumps(result["plan"], separators=(",", ":")) + "\n")
    return 0 if result["status"] in {"qualified", "unchanged", "delivered"} else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Real-Git behavior of the separate, closed nine-file Projects repair."""
from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import shlex
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest import mock

from test_deliver_g6_catalog import CatalogWorkspace, delivery, rt
from delivery_support import ROOT, git
from test_delivery_workflow import Workflow
import yaml


class GateWorkspace(CatalogWorkspace):
    """Start with acquired catalog files, then review only nine gate prerequisites."""
    def __init__(self, root):
        super().__init__(root)
        git(self.projects, "commit", "--quiet", "-m", "test: previously delivered acquisition")
        existing = (delivery.GATES_PATHS[0], *delivery.GATES_PATHS[6:])
        for path in existing:
            target = self.projects / path
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_bytes(b"# existing prerequisite retained at the reviewed base\n")
        git(self.projects, "add", "--", *existing)
        git(self.projects, "commit", "--quiet", "-m", "test: source with existing renderer")
        self.base = git(self.projects, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
        self.base_tree = git(self.projects, "rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}")
        self.before = self.items(self.projects, self.base)
        git(self.projects, "push", "--quiet", self.remote, "HEAD:main")
        for path in delivery.GATES_PATHS:
            target = self.projects / path
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_bytes(b'{"private":true}\n' if path.endswith(".json")
                               else b"raise RuntimeError('module code must never execute with the token')\n")
        git(self.projects, "add", "--", *delivery.GATES_PATHS)
        self.refresh_proposal()

    def refresh_proposal(self):
        self.patch = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(self.projects), "diff", "--cached", "--binary", self.base],
                                    capture_output=True, check=True).stdout
        self.result_tree = git(self.projects, "write-tree")
        self.after = self.items(self.projects, self.result_tree)
        self.value = {"schema": "hexalith.projects-ci-gates.v1", "repository": delivery.PROJECTS,
                      "pre_push_gate": "reviewed-tree-owner-authorized", "base_commit": self.base,
                      "base_tree": self.base_tree, "patch_sha256": delivery.digest(self.patch),
                      "result_tree": self.result_tree,
                      "before": {path: self.before.get(path) for path in delivery.GATES_PATHS},
                      "after": {path: self.after.get(path) for path in delivery.GATES_PATHS}}
        self.validation = {"schema": "hexalith.projects-ci-gates-validation.v1", "status": "passed",
                           **{field: self.value[field] for field in ("base_commit", "base_tree", "result_tree", "patch_sha256")},
                           "checks": {name: {"status": "passed", "log_sha256": "a" * 64}
                                      for name in delivery.GATES_CHECKS}}
        self.bind_validation(self.validation)

    def bind_validation(self, proof):
        self.validation_bytes = (json.dumps(proof) + "\n").encode()
        self.value["validation_sha256"] = delivery.digest(self.validation_bytes)
        self.save()

    def save(self):
        for path in delivery.GATES_SOURCES:
            target = self.owner / path
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            if path == delivery.GATES_MANIFEST:
                target.write_text(json.dumps(self.value) + "\n")
            elif path == delivery.GATES_VALIDATION:
                target.write_bytes(self.validation_bytes)
            else:
                target.write_bytes(self.patch if path == delivery.GATES_PATCH else (ROOT / path).read_bytes())
        git(self.owner, "add", ".")
        git(self.owner, "commit", "--quiet", "-m", "test: reviewed gate prerequisites")
        self.sha = git(self.owner, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
        git(self.owner, "push", "--quiet", self.owner_remote, "HEAD:main")

    def context(self):
        return super().context() | {"G6_PROFILE": "ci-gates", "G6_BEHAVIORAL_RESULT": "success", "GITHUB_WORKFLOW_REF":
            "Hexalith/Hexalith.CiCd/" + delivery.GATES_WORKFLOW + "@refs/heads/main"}

    def run(self, operation="qualify", *, profile="ci-gates", **context):
        self.read_counts.clear()
        return delivery.execute(operation, self.context() | context, self.report_path, transport=self.transport,
                                token=self.token if operation == "deliver" else "", scratch=self.root,
                                local_root=self.owner, profile=profile)

    def cli_call(self, operation="qualify", *, script=None, args=None, cwd=None, **extra):
        configuration = self.root / "gate-config.json"
        configuration.write_text(json.dumps({"cicd": str(self.owner_remote),
            "modules": {delivery.PROJECTS: str(self.remote)}, "acquisitions": str(self.root / "cli-acquisitions.jsonl"),
            "push_fail": [], "races": {}}))
        output = self.root / "gate-output"
        output.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        environment = os.environ | self.context() | {"GITHUB_OUTPUT": str(output), "TMPDIR": str(self.root),
            "MODULE_TOKEN": self.token if operation == "deliver" else "", "CICD_TOKEN": ""}
        for key, value in extra.items():
            if value is None:
                environment.pop(key, None)
            else:
                environment[key] = value
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", str(ROOT / "tools/tests/delivery_support.py"), "driver",
            str(script or self.owner / "tools/deliver_g6_catalog.py"), str(configuration),
            *(args or [operation, "--profile", "ci-gates", "--report", str(self.report_path)])],
            capture_output=True, cwd=cwd, env=environment)
        return result, output.read_text() if output.exists() else ""

    def cli_qualify(self, **extra):
        return self.cli_call(**extra)



class GateWorkflow(Workflow):
    """Run the actual owner job mapping; substitute only actions and suite outcome."""
    def __init__(self, workspace, *, job="validate", plan=None, validation="success", suite_result="success",
                 mint_fail=False, ref="refs/heads/main", event="workflow_dispatch"):
        super().__init__(workspace, job=job, event=event, ref=ref, validation=validation, suite_result=suite_result)
        self.document = yaml.safe_load((ROOT / delivery.GATES_WORKFLOW).read_bytes())
        self.job = self.document["jobs"][job]
        self.context["github"]["workflow_ref"] = "Hexalith/Hexalith.CiCd/" + delivery.GATES_WORKFLOW + "@refs/heads/main"
        self.context["needs"]["validate"]["outputs"] = {"plan": json.dumps(plan) if plan else ""}
        self.mint_fails = mint_fail
        self.outputs = {}

    def execute(self):
        triggers = self.document.get("on", self.document.get(True))
        if self.context["github"]["event_name"] not in triggers:
            return "not-triggered"
        self.concurrency_group = self.expand(self.document["concurrency"]["group"])
        mutex = self.job.get("concurrency", {})
        self.writer_concurrency_group = mutex.get("group")
        self.writer_cancel_in_progress = mutex.get("cancel-in-progress")
        if not self.condition(self.job.get("if", "success()")):
            return "skipped"
        base = self.w.context() | {"MODULE_TOKEN": "", "CICD_TOKEN": ""}
        base.update({"GITHUB_" + key.upper(): str(value) for key, value in self.context["github"].items() if key != "token"})
        working = self.w.owner if self.job_name == "validate" else self.w.root
        for ordinal, step in enumerate(self.job["steps"]):
            identifier = step.get("id", f"step_{ordinal}")
            if not self.condition(step.get("if", "success()")):
                self.finish_step(identifier, step, "skipped", {})
                continue
            outputs, outcome = {}, "success"
            if "uses" in step:
                inputs = {key: self.expand(value) for key, value in step.get("with", {}).items()}
                self.actions.append((step["uses"], inputs))
                action = step["uses"].split("@", 1)[0]
                if action == "actions/checkout":
                    if inputs.get("submodules") is not False or inputs.get("persist-credentials") is not False:
                        raise AssertionError("unsafe owner checkout")
                    if self.job_name == "deliver":
                        if inputs.get("ref") != self.w.sha:
                            raise AssertionError("checkout is not the exact qualified owner")
                        destination = working / inputs["path"]
                        for path in inputs["sparse-checkout"].splitlines():
                            target = destination / path
                            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                            target.write_bytes(subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(self.w.owner), "show",
                                self.w.sha + ":" + path], check=True, capture_output=True).stdout)
                    self.checkouts.append(inputs)
                elif action == "astral-sh/setup-uv":
                    pass
                elif action == "actions/create-github-app-token":
                    self.mints.append(inputs)
                    if inputs.get("owner") != "Hexalith" or inputs.get("repositories") != delivery.PROJECTS or \
                            inputs.get("permission-contents") != "write" or any(
                                key.startswith("permission-") and key != "permission-contents" for key in inputs):
                        raise AssertionError("gate repair token exceeds Projects Contents write")
                    if self.mint_fails:
                        outcome = "failure"
                    else:
                        outputs["token"] = self.w.token
                elif action == "actions/upload-artifact":
                    artifact = working / inputs["path"]
                    if artifact.is_file():
                        self.uploads.append((inputs["name"], artifact.read_bytes()))
                    elif inputs.get("if-no-files-found") == "error":
                        outcome = "failure"
                else:
                    raise AssertionError("unhandled external action " + action)
            elif identifier == "tests":
                # The suite I/O is replaced; its actual outcome feeds the real qualifier.
                outcome = self.suite_result
            else:
                command = shlex.split(step["run"])
                if command[:2] != ["python3", "-I"]:
                    raise AssertionError("writer command is not isolated Python")
                environment = base | {key: self.expand(value) for key, value in step.get("env", {}).items()}
                process, output = self.w.cli_call(command[3], script=working / command[2], args=command[3:],
                                                cwd=working, **environment)
                self.commands.append(command)
                self.processes.append(process)
                outcome = "success" if process.returncode == 0 else "failure"
                outputs = dict(row.split("=", 1) for row in output.splitlines())
            self.finish_step(identifier, step, outcome, outputs)
        if self.job_name == "validate":
            self.outputs = {key: self.expand(value) for key, value in self.job.get("outputs", {}).items()}
        return "failure" if self.failed else "success"


class GateDeliveryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):

        self.addCleanup(temporary.cleanup)

        original = rt.environment
        def file_transport():
            result = original()
            i = int(result["GIT_CONFIG_COUNT"])
            result.update(GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=str(i + 1))
            result[f"GIT_CONFIG_KEY_{i}"] = "protocol.file.allow"
            result[f"GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_{i}"] = "always"
            return result
        self.environment_patch = mock.patch.object(rt, "environment", side_effect=file_transport)
        self.environment_patch.start()
        self.addCleanup(self.environment_patch.stop)

    def refused(self, result, reason):
        self.assertEqual(result["status"], "failed")
        self.assertIn(reason, result["reason"])
        self.assertEqual(self.w.pushes, [])
        self.assertEqual(git(self.w.remote, "rev-parse", "main"), self.w.base)

    def test_cli_qualification_output_feeds_writer_and_preserves_catalog_and_gitlink(self):
        w = self.w
        code, output = w.cli_qualify()
        self.assertEqual(code.returncode, 0, code.stderr)
        actual_plan = json.loads(dict(row.split("=", 1) for row in output.splitlines())["plan"])
        qualified = json.loads(w.report_path.read_bytes())
        self.assertEqual(qualified["plan"], actual_plan)
        self.assertEqual(actual_plan["schema"], "hexalith.projects-ci-gates-plan.v1")
        self.assertEqual(actual_plan["profile"], "ci-gates")
        self.assertEqual(actual_plan["module_validation_sha256"], w.value["validation_sha256"])
        result = w.run("deliver", G6_QUALIFICATION="success", G6_PLAN=json.dumps(actual_plan))
        self.assertEqual(result["status"], "delivered", result)
        self.assertEqual(result["schema"], "hexalith.projects-ci-gates-delivery.v1")
        self.assertEqual(git(w.remote, "rev-parse", result["delivered_sha"] + "^"), w.base)
        self.assertEqual(w.items(w.remote, result["delivered_sha"]), w.after)
        for path, entry in w.before.items():
            if path not in delivery.GATES_PATHS:
                self.assertEqual(w.after[path], entry)
        self.assertEqual(git(w.remote, "show", "main", "--format=%B", "--no-patch"),
                         "build(cicd): restore reviewed Projects gate prerequisites")

    def test_unknown_profile_mismatched_context_and_wrong_workflow_refuse_before_writing(self):
        cases = (("unreviewed", {}, "unknown closed"),

                 ("ci-gates", {"G6_PROFILE": None}, "profile differs"),
                 ("ci-gates", {"GITHUB_WORKFLOW_REF": "other-owner-workflow"}, "ineligible gate-repair"))

.github/workflows/deliver-projects-ci-ga.text:
name: Deliver reviewed Projects gate repair

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: deliver-projects-ci-gates
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  validate:
    if: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      plan: ${{ steps.qualify.outputs.plan }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout CiCd source without dependencies or persisted credentials
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          submodules: false
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Setup pinned uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@68559e99cc807c1eb7e9238fd43a15bba460eec2 # v10.3.3
        with:
          version: '0.13.7'
          enable-cache: false

      - name: Qualify both closed delivery profiles without secrets
        id: tests
        run: |
          uv run --locked --script --python 3.12 tools/tests/test_deliver_g6_catalog.py
          uv run --locked --script --python 3.12 tools/tests/test_deliver_projects_ci_gates.py

      - name: Bind reviewed nine-file repair to current exact sources
        id: qualify
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        env:
          G6_OWNER_SOURCE: ${{ github.sha }}
          G6_PROFILE: ci-gates
          G6_BEHAVIORAL_RESULT: ${{ steps.tests.outcome }}
        run: python3 -I tools/deliver_g6_catalog.py qualify --profile ci-gates --report projects-ci-gates-qualification.json

      - name: Upload qualification receipt
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: projects-ci-gates-qualification
          path: projects-ci-gates-qualification.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 90

  deliver:
    needs: validate
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && needs.validate.result == 'success' && needs.validate.outputs.plan != '' }}
    concurrency:
      group: deliver-owned-writes
      cancel-in-progress: false
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    environment: cicd-app
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact qualified owner source
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          path: .ci-gates-owner
          sparse-checkout: |
            tools/deliver_g6_catalog.py
            tools/delivery_runtime.py
            docs/proposals/projects-ci-gates.json
            docs/proposals/projects-ci-gates.patch
            docs/proposals/projects-ci-gates-validation.json
            .github/workflows/deliver-projects-ci-gates.yml
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          submodules: false
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Mint only Projects content correction token
        id: token
        timeout-minutes: 1
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@64ab729a6294000f5aa4a4bc0b73d1f32bc45510 # v3.3.0
        with:
          client-id: ${{ vars.HEXALITH_CICD_APP_CLIENT_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.HEXALITH_CICD_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          owner: Hexalith
          repositories: Hexalith.Projects
          permission-contents: write

      - name: Apply only the exact qualified nine-file repair
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        env:
          G6_OWNER_SOURCE: ${{ github.sha }}
          G6_PROFILE: ci-gates
          G6_QUALIFICATION: ${{ needs.validate.result }}
          G6_PLAN: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.plan }}
          MODULE_TOKEN: ${{ steps.token.outputs.token }}
        run: python3 -I .ci-gates-owner/tools/deliver_g6_catalog.py deliver --profile ci-gates --report projects-ci-gates-delivery.json

      - name: Upload delivery receipt
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: projects-ci-gates-delivery
          path: projects-ci-gates-delivery.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90

vulnerabilities; the unchanged module policy accepts the delivery subject and

the full writer, non-forced single child push and retained failure receipts.

qualification plans fail closed. No module code runs in the credentialed writer.

existing pinned App action, and `deliver-owned-writes` job mutex. Its App token

36-minute controller budget with receipt margin. The continuing owner authorization

and positive/negative message cases against the unchanged module commit policy.

cases and review before dispatch. Local results do not establish hosted G-6
acceptance. After delivery, collect new CI/Commitlint/G-6 observations bound to
the actual committed Projects SHA and retain any further failure without
weakening gates or restoring unrelated publication configuration.

acceptance remains pending actual owner delivery and a fresh module run.

and its eleven advanced gitlinks. The unchanged repair patch produces complete

validation artifact has SHA256 `8f3a9ebe6e802c6ae813d2a07f099b0810eceae797fe98b65ef22e49571b7715`.

The proposal uses Git binary-patch encoding to preserve historical CRLF blobs
